result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Determine whether to build a dedicated handoff tracking product tailored for small software development teams in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Investigation of engineering handoff processes, asynchronous communication practices, and operational context sharing in small software teams in Latvia.
- Assessment of alternative tools currently used for sprint transitions, daily status tracking, and handoff documentation.
- Exclusion of payroll, compensation tracking, and financial advisory functionality.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Lead

Technical managers responsible for sprint execution, developer context handoffs, and team operational efficiency in small software teams.

- How many hours do team members typically spend preparing and communicating handoff context at the end of each work cycle? (question-6cb71d0d6a0ece3e5ece1eda)
- What steps and tools are currently used to transfer technical context between engineers when tasks or feature ownership change hands? (question-75219692d0d76be7d82fc657)

## Product Manager

Product and delivery managers coordinating milestone handoffs, status tracking, and cross-functional communication.

- Under what conditions would your team adopt a dedicated handoff tool instead of configuring existing issue trackers or documentation workspaces? (question-209f5a0a1829e199b34d0fee)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software engineering teams in Latvia routinely conduct scheduled weekly handoff or status updates.
- Manual copying and consolidation of status updates is an operational bottleneck shared by multiple teams beyond the synthetic interview scenario.

## Evidence gaps

- No verified empirical market data on software development workflows or handoff practices specific to Latvian small software teams.
- No commercial validation indicating willingness to pay for or integrate a standalone handoff tracking product.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
